title: Name/secure License+provenance and Bioinformatics reviewers (blocking gate roles)
context: genome-browser-tracks requires two mandatory reviewer roles before any pack can be reviewed: a License+provenance reviewer (who can read open-data/bioinformatics licenses and apply the data-tier rule) and a Bioinformatics reviewer (who verifies assembly/coordinate correctness, format validity, and render checks). Both are blocking prerequisites — no source can pass the gate and no pilot pack can be reviewed until both roles are named. This task secures those commitments before M0 work begins.
objective: Identify and confirm at least one qualified person for each mandatory reviewer role (License+provenance and Bioinformatics), document their commitment and qualifications, and record the named roles in a committed artifact.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one named, qualified License+provenance reviewer is confirmed and documented (can read CC0/CC-BY/public-domain/NC licenses and apply the cancer data-tier rule).
At least one named, qualified Bioinformatics reviewer is confirmed and documented (genomics-literate; can verify assembly, coordinate convention, format validity, and render checks).
Each role has ≥2 qualified reviewers identified to meet the bus-factor requirement stated in PLAN.md.
A committed document records names, qualifications, and confirmation dates for each role.
Document output licensed CC-BY-4.0; commit is DCO signed-off.
output: review/reviewer-roles.md — committed document naming both mandatory reviewer roles with qualifications and confirmation dates, unblocking the M0 pilot gate review.
